market_education.summary_en: Broad market strength today pushed both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 higher, with tech and growth names leading the advance. Rising volume alongside bullish MACD crossovers across several small and mid-cap names suggests institutional buyers are stepping back in rather than just short-term speculation. No single headline-driven catalyst stands out; this looks like a broad risk-on rotation.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍走強，納斯達克及標普500指數同步上揚，科技及增長股領漲。多隻中小型股出現MACD黃金交叉並伴隨成交量放大，顯示機構資金正重新進場，而非單純短線投機。今次未見單一新聞觸發因素，較似是一次廣泛的風險偏好（risk-on）輪動。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of buying on just one bullish sign, strong traders wait for several indicators — like RSI, MACD, price trend, and trading volume — to all point the same direction at once. When multiple signals agree, it's more likely real money (not just noise) is driving the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 強勢的交易者不會只憑單一利好訊號就買入，而是等待多個指標——例如RSI、MACD、價格趨勢及成交量——同時指向同一方向。當多個訊號一致時，代表背後很可能有真實資金流入，而非單純市場雜訊。
